title: synth-vdr tool output
description: The shape a diligence tool's findings are read in as, for scoring against a room's answer key via `python3 -m synthvdr score`. room_hash should be the room's `_key/manifest.json` content_hash at the time the tool was run against it — carried through so a scorecard can state whether it was produced against the room it is being scored against.

tool.description: Name and version of the tool under test, e.g. "acme/1.0".

room_hash.description: The room's `_key/manifest.json` content_hash at the time this output was produced, if known. Empty or omitted means provenance cannot be verified — the scorecard reports this as UNVERIFIED rather than silently assuming a match.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the reported finding.

documents.description: Relative paths to the documents this finding cites. Used for the deterministic pre-match against a finding's source and corroboration documents.

summary.description: Free-text description of the reported finding.
